label: Bible Study
prompt: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy _____, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
verse: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
note: The Preacher's advice to the young — remember your Creator before the hard days arrive.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right _____, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
verse: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
note: God holding your right hand while saying 'fear not' — like a parent crossing a busy street with a child.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and _____ it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
verse: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
note: 'Slang' is the KJV's past tense of sling — one stone, one shot, and Goliath fell face first.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have _____, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
verse: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
note: John cites this at the cross after the soldier's spear: 'They shall look on him whom they pierced.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Hope _____ maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verse: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
note: 'Hope deferred' — put off, postponed — and Proverbs admits it makes the heart sick. Honest wisdom.
